_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Saturday — regulator coordination capstone + Chinese open-weight launch. (1) Bank of England formally joins Treasury/Fed/BoC — BoE CMORG + CMORG AI Taskforce within two weeks with HMT/FCA/NCSC attending; Anthropic to bring Mythos directly to UK banks within following week; 96hr transatlantic playbook is most-coordinated regulator-to-regulator AI capability response on record. (2) MiniMax M2.7 weights ship on HuggingFace — sparse 230B MoE, 10B active, 256 experts, 200K context; 'modified MIT' licence (commercial use requires written authorisation) becomes the new flashpoint in open-weights debate. (3) Meta Muse Spark moves to private API preview — no waitlist, hand-picked partners only; zero third-party API providers benchmarking as of mid-April; closed-weights pivot cemented. (4) Mythos crosses into mainstream consumer press within 96hr — CP24 (Toronto), Progressive Robot, syndicated outlets all run 'too dangerous to release' frame; future capability disclosures will be staged with this consumer-press response in mind. (5) Nathan Lambert 'inevitable need for an open model consortium' — argues as frontier models get more internally valuable, for-profit funding structures supporting open-weights frontier work will break down on 2+ year horizon; multi-company consortium the only long-term-stable path. Research: MCP-DPT (layer-aligned defense-placement taxonomy for MCP — first defense-placement view rather than attack-catalog framing); Securing Retrieval-Augmented Generation; Graph of Skills (between SKILL0 in-weight and SkillClaw collective-evolution); Cross-Tokenizer LLM Distillation through Byte-Level Interface; ClawBench (153 tasks, frontier ~33% success); Silencing the Guardrails (refusal-suppression at inference).

sectors.name: Methods & research
sectors.description: Depth Ceiling — LLMs execute latent reasoning at varying depths but consistently fail to discover the right multi-step planning strategies — discovery and execution dissociate. SEVerA Formally Guarded Generative Models with first-order-logic specifications + Dafny verification.
